cross_ea_mechanism_map.b16_evidence: H05 found a positive GBPUSD/H4 RSI center that was economically thinner; H08 found a USDJPY/H1 MAIN plateau whose locked center failed BWD.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.b15_evidence: CountBars=3 improved GBPUSD/H4 locally but left the preregistered cross-home dual-positive count unchanged at 1/3.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.reuse_lesson: A local parameter improvement is not transport evidence. Freeze selection before BWD and close the path when the prospective portability test fails; do not rescue it adaptively.

cross_ea_mechanism_map.b16_evidence: Depth is structural and context-specific; GBPUSD/H4 depth2 preserves aggregate sign but loses 2025 utility, while depth3 restores all-six-year positivity and closes the bounded depth question.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.boss19_evidence: Repair03 makes one-cell unit provenance admissible, but no Boss19 depth mechanism is established because broad P4 unit attribution has not been executed/interpreted.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.reuse_lesson: Do not transfer a B16 depth rule into Boss19. Repair03 only restores trustworthy unit provenance; Boss19 mechanism claims still require admissible P4 evidence and interpretation.

cross_ea_mechanism_map.b16_evidence: H08 BWD failure is accepted strategy evidence after mechanical acceptance.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.boss19_evidence: Repair02 was a historical instrumentation/provenance failure; Repair03 resolved that defect while preserving non-swap execution identity. Neither event is a Boss19 strategy verdict.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.reuse_lesson: Mechanical/instrumentation failure and strategy failure must remain separate evidence classes; neither can substitute for the other.

cross_ea_mechanism_map.b16_evidence: USDJPY exit-off children improve aggregate net/DD but collapse yearly closures and create very long-lived concentrated episodes; H05 also shrinks participation materially.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.boss19_evidence: UNKNOWN at broad regime/unit level. Repair03 proves one-cell source provenance but does not provide broad participation or concentration attribution.
cross_ea_mechanism_map.reuse_lesson: Headline PF/net/DD alone is insufficient when realized participation or holding concentration changes materially.
